checks.exists_eq_smul_hemiChart: For l ≠ 0 (Fact) and j : ℝⁿ → openHemisphere l, IsAffine ℝ j (Déf. 2's predicate, for Déf. 6's AddTorsor) and injective, ∃ σ : GSR n, ∀ y, j y = σ • s(y, 1). The proof lifts j to the affine hyperplane l = 1 (hemiEquivLevelOne), builds the endomorphism L(y, t) = a.linear y + t·a(0) of ℝⁿ⁺¹, proves it injective (l kills the linear part and is 1 on a(0); injectivity of j on the linear part), and takes σ = [LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo L]. Correct; the hypotheses are satisfiable (hemiChartH: isAffine_hemiChartH, bijective_hemiChartH, instantiated in scratch). Since every open hemisphere of S(n) is openHemisphere l for some l ≠ 0 (Déf. 5) and the structure does not depend on l (hemi_vadd_indep), this covers every « isomorphisme compatible avec la structure affine de ℝⁿ sur un hémisphère »
